create_VocabParallelEmbedding: create a vocab-parallel embedding layer that shards the vocabulary dimension across multiple GPUs
build_vocab_shard_indices: build shard indices for distributing vocab parallel embedding weights across tensor-parallel ranks
test_pad_vocab_size: test padding a vocabulary size to the nearest multiple of the given pad value
compute_vocab_range_global: compute the token ID range for a given tensor-parallel rank and world size
mask_and_offset_vocab_input: mask and offset vocab input tokens to support mixed base and added vocab ranges in parallel embedding
